decision: GO for PR-only contract and offline verifier; NO-GO for merge until review/test and NO-GO for all live actions

perspectives.summary: Use codicarium/infra, immutable numeric identities and source revisions, exact root tool and sudo contracts, DESIRED_ONLY evidence.
Require fixed root-owned non-writable realpaths, exact command tuples, no checkout execution, independent state verification, and adversarial coverage.
Require deterministic isolated positive/negative fixtures and proof of no mutation or sensitive output.

external_gates: A later slice must install the reviewed immutable bundle through a declarative owner and prove live state.
PR #1246 protected apply and group-6 apply authorization remain prohibited.
ARC producer activation remains prohibited until the authority-runner boundary and downstream gates pass.
